summary: Iteration 2 testing of DACOT Hub module handoff. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests passed (launch-token happy path with full JWT claim validation, role non-authority, 400 for inactive/in-dev modules, 404 for unknown tenant/module, 401 unauthenticated, unique jti, activity log 'module.launch_token_issued'; public status endpoint 401 without/with wrong X-Module-Key, 200 with ORDERS_MODULE_KEY, 404 for unknown tenant/module before key check, no admin data leakage, delivery 401 as expected; regression on login/me/wrong-password, dashboard stats, modules catalog, tenants CRUD + kitchen activate/launch-token/deactivate->400). Frontend E2E: login -> Clientes -> Hamburgueria Exemplo -> aba Módulos -> 'Abrir módulo' (open-orders) triggers POST launch-token (200) and window.open('https://pedidos.dacot.app/hamburgueria-exemplo?handoff=<JWT>') with the JWT byte-identical to the backend response; HANDOFF_JWT_SECRET absent from served JS bundles; kitchen toggle activate/deactivate works with state refetch.

issues: Console React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' from the status <select> (STATUS_OPTS map) — caused by the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping the option text; harmless in prod but noisy in dev console
Status selector is a native <select> ('STATUS: ATIVO') rather than a shadcn Select — inconsistent with the rest of the design system

critical_code_review_comments: public_module_status returns {active:false} (200) with no 'module' key when the module is inactive — response shape differs between active/inactive; consider always returning module key for consumer simplicity.

launch-token accepts role from body when whitelisted (waiter/manager/kitchen) — verified server-side whitelist works, but the Hub UI never sends role, so consider dropping the body param entirely to reduce attack surface.
No natural test case exists for an active module without launch_url (both orders and kitchen have launch_url_template), so the 'Configure a URL de acesso' toast path is untested (N/A).
